AI Consulting & Team Training in Coimbatore: packages and prices

Hands-on workshops and a clear roadmap so your team uses AI safely and gets real results.

Quick answer

AI Consulting & Team Training from Vintorex Digital Solutions in Coimbatore starts at ₹34,999 for the Workshop package and goes up to ₹1,49,999 for AI Roadmap, excluding 18% GST. Typical market prices run ₹75,000 to ₹2,50,000. Delivery: 1–3 weeks to schedule.

Overview

Practical sessions built on your own tasks, not generic slides. Your team learns to write good prompts, choose tools, check AI output and protect data, and leaves with a prompt library. The roadmap option adds a short discovery project that ranks AI opportunities by value and effort.

Ideal for

  • Owners and managers who want a practical start with AI
  • Teams already using AI tools without any rules or training
  • Companies deciding where chatbots, automation or custom AI would pay off
